pages.title: Function Graph
pages.text: A rule that sends each input to exactly one output, drawn as a curve of light through the plane. Some are smooth, some are jagged, and some are discontinuous everywhere. It hangs in the air as a luminous thread that never doubles back on itself vertically.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A photonic neuron fires once for each input it is given; aimed across the real continuum, it traced every input to its output. The Analytic Continuator kept the beam as a permanent curve rather than a flash.
